summary_1line: Before departing for exile, Rama distributes his wealth generously to brahmins, servants, and the needy, including gifting many cows to the poor brahmin Trijata.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama and Lakshmana stand before heaps of gold and silver in the palace as they distribute riches to brahmins, servants, and the poor.
The poor brahmin Trijata, dressed in tattered rags, whirls his staff and hurls it across the Sarayu toward a distant herd of royal cows.
Thousands of royal cows and bulls grazing by the Sarayu are driven toward the humble hermitage of the astonished brahmin Trijata.
